snippet.title: NEW GAME! CandyCraft: Play Delicious With Amos 4D Gummy BlockmanGo
snippet.description:
You were born on an isolated island, and now heading to the candy kingdom to fight monsters, mining or PVP with other players to obtain resources through your own efforts. You can buy all kinds of gummy blocks and candy seeds in the store to build and develop the island; You can also buy all kinds of candy armor or privileges to arm yourself and build your island into a super candy kingdom! 



Feel free to invite friends from all over the world to party on your island, while you can earn points for building island and can be ranked on the billboard with higher points against other players and therefore gain a higher exposure rate of your building works...
